strings.d1.s0.name: Piazza San Marco
strings.d1.s0.tips: Pigeons and an empty square at 07:30, perfect for photos. After 10:00 it gets packed.
strings.d1.s1.name: Basilica di San Marco
strings.d1.s1.tips: Golden mosaics. Book a timed ticket online (12 EUR); the Pala d'Oro costs extra. Shoulders and knees must be covered.
strings.d1.s2.name: Palazzo Ducale
strings.d1.s2.tips: The Doge's Palace and the Bridge of Sighs. Book online; the Secret Itineraries tour is optional.
strings.d1.s3.name: Campanile di San Marco
strings.d1.s3.tips: Take the lift up the bell tower for views over the lagoon.
strings.d1.s4.name: Rosticceria Gislon
strings.d1.s4.tips: Standing counter behind San Marco. Try the mozzarella in carrozza (fried mozzarella sandwich) and arancini (rice balls). Cheap.
strings.d1.b0.name: Caffè Florian
strings.d1.b0.tips: The square's café since 1720. The orchestra costs extra.
strings.d1.b1.name: Museo Correr
strings.d1.b1.tips: Included with the Doge's Palace ticket. A museum on the square itself.
strings.d2.s0.name: Rialto Fish Market
strings.d2.s0.tips: Morning market with seafood and vegetables. Closed on Mondays.
strings.d2.s1.name: Ponte di Rialto
strings.d2.s1.tips: The bridge over the Grand Canal. Quiet in the morning.
strings.d2.s2.name: Cantina Do Mori
strings.d2.s2.tips: A bacaro (Venetian wine bar) since 1462. Eat cicchetti (small bites) and drink an ombra (small glass of wine), standing.
strings.d2.s3.name: Cannaregio Ghetto
strings.d2.s3.tips: The world's first ghetto, with tall houses and synagogues.
strings.d2.s4.name: Fondamenta della Misericordia
strings.d2.s4.tips: A row of canalside bacari in Cannaregio, including Vino Vero and Al Timon. Come in the evening.
strings.d2.b0.name: Al Timon Cannaregio
strings.d2.b0.tips: Tables on a boat, and cicchetti.
strings.d2.b1.name: Ca' d'Oro
strings.d2.b1.tips: A Gothic palace on the Grand Canal. Visit it instead of the Ghetto.
strings.d3.s0.name: Gallerie dell'Accademia
strings.d3.s0.tips: Venetian painting: Bellini, Titian, Veronese. Book online.
strings.d3.s1.name: Peggy Guggenheim Collection
strings.d3.s1.tips: Modern art on the canal, with a garden.
strings.d3.s2.name: Punta della Dogana
strings.d3.s2.tips: The tip of the canal, with the Salute church and San Marco across the water.
strings.d3.s3.name: Cantine del Vino già Schiavi
strings.d3.s3.tips: A legendary cicchetti bar. Stand by the canal; it closes at 14:30.
strings.d3.s4.name: Zattere Waterfront
strings.d3.s4.tips: Walk along the Giudecca Canal and try the gianduiotto (chocolate-hazelnut gelato) at Gelateria Nico.
strings.d3.b0.name: Osteria al Squero
strings.d3.b1.name: Squero di San Trovaso
strings.d3.b1.tips: A gondola-building boatyard. View it from the outside.
strings.d4.s0.name: Murano Glass Workshop
strings.d4.s0.tips: Take vaporetto 4.1 or 4.2 (day pass 25 EUR). Watch a glassblowing demonstration; the Murano Glass Museum costs 10 EUR.
strings.d4.s1.name: Museo del Vetro Murano
strings.d4.s2.name: Burano Colourful Houses
strings.d4.s2.tips: Take vaporetto 12 for 40 minutes. Brightly painted fishermen's houses and a leaning bell tower.
strings.d4.s3.name: Trattoria al Gatto Nero Burano
strings.d4.s3.tips: Burano's famous risotto di gò (goby fish risotto). Book ahead.
strings.d4.s4.name: Mazzorbo Venissa Vineyard
strings.d4.s4.tips: An island linked to Burano by a bridge. A walled vineyard and a quiet stroll; return by vaporetto.
strings.d4.b0.name: Burano Bussolà Bakery
strings.d4.b0.tips: Bussolà biscuits. Choose this instead of Gatto Nero.
strings.d4.b1.name: Torcello Santa Maria Assunta
strings.d4.b1.tips: A cathedral with Byzantine mosaics. Visit it instead of Mazzorbo.
strings.d5.s0.name: Arsenale di Venezia
strings.d5.s0.tips: The shipyard gate and its lions. Exhibitions run in Biennale years (May to November).
strings.d5.s1.name: Via Garibaldi
strings.d5.s1.tips: A local Castello street, good for breakfast and the market.
strings.d5.s2.name: Giardini della Biennale
strings.d5.s2.tips: The Biennale gardens. A park when there is no exhibition.
strings.d5.s3.name: San Pietro di Castello
strings.d5.s3.tips: Venice's old cathedral, on a quiet island.
strings.d5.s4.name: Trattoria alla Rampa del Piave
strings.d5.s4.tips: A local trattoria on Via Garibaldi. Seafood pasta.
strings.d5.b0.name: El Refolo Via Garibaldi
strings.d5.b1.name: Scuola di San Giorgio degli Schiavoni
strings.d5.b1.tips: Carpaccio's painting cycle. Visit it instead of San Pietro.
strings.d6.s0.name: San Giorgio Maggiore
strings.d6.s0.tips: Take vaporetto 2 to the island. A Palladio church, and the bell tower gives the best view of San Marco.
strings.d6.s1.name: Giudecca Walk
strings.d6.s1.tips: A quiet island across from Zattere, with the Redentore church.
strings.d6.s2.name: Trattoria Altanella Giudecca
strings.d6.s3.name: Gondola Ride
strings.d6.s3.tips: The official tariff is 90 EUR for 30 minutes (110 EUR at night). Depart from Bacino Orseolo.
strings.d6.s4.name: Vaporetto 1 Grand Canal at Sunset
strings.d6.s4.tips: Line 1 from Piazzale Roma to San Marco. Grab a front seat for the palace façades.
strings.d6.b0.name: Harry's Dolci Giudecca
strings.d6.b0.tips: Cipriani's pastry shop and restaurant on Giudecca. Choose it instead of Altanella.
strings.d6.b1.name: Fondazione Cini
strings.d6.b1.tips: A monastery tour on San Giorgio. Visit it instead of Giudecca.
strings.d7.s0.name: Scuola Grande di San Rocco
strings.d7.s0.tips: Sixty paintings by Tintoretto. Use a mirror to see the ceiling.
strings.d7.s1.name: Frari Basilica
strings.d7.s1.tips: Titian's Assumption in a Gothic church.
strings.d7.s2.name: Pasticceria Tonolo
strings.d7.s2.tips: Venice's best pastry shop. Try the cream pastries and frittelle (carnival fritters).
strings.d7.s3.name: Campo Santa Margherita
strings.d7.s3.tips: The students' square. Have a last spritz.
strings.d7.s4.name: Piazzale Roma / Vaporetto Alilaguna
strings.d7.s4.tips: To Marco Polo airport, take the Alilaguna boat (1 hour) or the bus (20 minutes). Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Osteria Bancogiro
strings.d7.b1.name: Ca' Pesaro
strings.d7.b1.tips: A palace of modern art. Visit it instead of San Rocco.
strings.note0: A single vaporetto ticket costs 9.50 EUR, a 72-hour pass 45 EUR. Venice is best explored on foot (getting lost is normal). From Marco Polo airport, take the Alilaguna boat or the bus.
strings.note1: Day-visitor fee: 5-10 EUR on certain days from April to July (hotel guests are exempt). San Marco and the Doge's Palace require timed online tickets.
strings.note2: Summer brings 30°C heat, humidity and crowds. Visit San Marco at 07:30 and the islands in the afternoon. Mosquitoes in August.
strings.note3: Standing at a bacaro, cicchetti cost 1.5-3 EUR and an ombra 2 EUR. A sit-down meal runs 25-40 EUR, and a café on San Marco 10+ EUR.
strings.note4: Coperto (cover charge) is 3-5 EUR. The official gondola tariff is 90 EUR for 30 minutes and can be shared (up to 6 people).
strings.note5: Watch for pickpockets on bridges and in crowds. Suitcase wheels are a nightmare on cobbles, so pack light.
